description: How it works (Build.Rite): every flow of the team's tools — Issues, Code fix, Application pages, Jira stories and AI analysis, the FDD library, standup minutes, follow-ups, the data branch, the AI — step by step: who does each step (you, the AI, the agent, the app, git, Jira), its side paths, where what it makes is kept, and a button to open it. Its words are in resources/js/flowsGuide.js.
